payload.title: badge-always-visible rework (f8732965): shard achieved; alias-to-anchor statusLine is the one shape left out of reach
payload.body: The second rework closes the flow-mapping and unreadable-preset gap. In a live omp install into a temp HOME, a multi-line flow statusLine with 'showHookStatus: false' had only that value turned to true, and the operator was told. A dry run on the landed dist did the same for a one-line flow mapping, a quoted key with a trailing comment, a preset alias, and a file whose top level is a flow mapping. A 'showHookStatus: false' under another top-level key was left alone, as was a commented-out one. python yaml parsed every edited file with only that value changed. status-line.test.ts passes, 78 tests. One shape is left, and the code comment names it: 'statusLine: *b', where the anchor holds a mapping written elsewhere with showHookStatus: false. That returns refused with hookRowShown false, so the badge appears nowhere. [INFERENCE] A '<<: *base' merge key inside statusLine behaves the same. I count this as a residual, not a failure of the shard, because the hidden value sits outside statusLine's own text. The design-holder may rule otherwise. The Claude path is unchanged from 91a71f81, which I had already verified live.
